I answered Ilse in a thread in #north-team: the main contact is **Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

- **The door 6 issue:** Thea reported the duplicate arrivals on door 6 during the morning shift. Dana Okafor posted this in #north-team on 2025-08-20 and said she'd look into it.
- **Main contact:** The North team cheat sheet also lists Thea as the account's main contact. That sheet has no date.
- **Possibly out of date:** The newest message I found on this issue is from August 2025, so I can't confirm who owns it now. Dana would know.
- **Name mix-up:** The cheat sheet says not to confuse this customer with Quarendon Freightways, a similar-sounding company that isn't a Pemberline customer.
